audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer says Yone wins all 7 stages (HARD 8/10); content and the packet give Mel all 7; WR is 49.04%. Neither blanket chart is credible and the layers disagree on every row.
audit.why: Could not adjudicate per row from the kits alone; chart left untouched, question raised.
Spike structure (range control 1-5, all-in denial at 6, burst-vs-shield race at items) is coherent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content assigns the projectile-reflect to Golden Eclipse (R) — 'pop R to reflect', 'your R turns his own damage back on him', 'reflects and executes his ult' — and calls Fate Sealed a 'taunt'. Mel's reflect is Rebuttal (W); her R strikes Overwhelm-marked enemies. Fate Sealed pulls, it does not taunt.
audit.why: Kit: mel W = reflect/damage-prevention barrier; mel R = strike marked enemies; yone R text = 'blinks behind... pulls all enemies hit towards him'.
audit.corrected: whys[4], whys[6], spikes[1], mid and late rewritten so W absorbs/blunts and R executes; 'taunt' removed. Also folded Yone's real ability names into the full layer (packet defect: none were named).

audit.why: Kit: Soul Unbound 22/19/16/13/10, Spirit Cleave 14 (scales with AS), Fate Sealed 120/100/80, Mel W 38-26.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rebuttal has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound: 22s at rank 1, 10s max — his burst window; survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. - Spirit Cleave shields him every 14s; trade after it breaks. - W Rebuttal (38s early) is for his all-in, nothing less. - R (120s) for the kill window only.

edits.before: Q-volley the last-hit, bank the overwhelm stacks, and keep W glowing — the chip is free while his best spells are hostages.
edits.after: Mortal Steel's Q3 gust and his Soul Unbound return are both dash commits — drop Solar Snare on the landing spot.

edits.before: Burning Rebuttal on chip and then eating the full rotation it existed to return — the reflect is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Two Mortal Steel stacks mean the Q3 knockup is loaded — sidestep the gust before you plant for a volley, or eat the pull.

edits.before: Golden Eclipse at 6 reflects and executes his ult, hard-countering the all-in that is his whole win condition.
edits.after: Rebuttal blunts his level 6 all-in and Golden Eclipse executes the Overwhelm you banked while he dived in.

edits.before: Two items plus you're a reflect engine he cannot dive without feeding his own combo back into himself.
edits.after: Two items plus, Rebuttal no-sells his dive window and Golden Eclipse ends him the moment it closes.

edits.before: Golden Eclipse is a nightmare for Yone because his entire threat is his all-in: when he R-taunts or dashes back to his spirit with E, pop R to reflect and execute. If he ults you, your R turns his own damage back on him, so his 6 all-in that beats most mages simply doesn't function into Mel.
edits.after: Golden Eclipse is a nightmare for Yone because his entire threat is his all-in: when he pulls you with Fate Sealed (R) or snaps back to his body with Soul Unbound (E), pop Rebuttal (W) to no-sell the burst, then execute with your R. The 6 all-in that beats most mages simply doesn't function into Mel.

edits.before: This is your zone. With E Solar Snare up you punish every Yone dash — snare him as he E-returns to his spirit and the fight is over before his knockup even threatens. At 6 your Golden Eclipse hard-counters his ult and his taunt-dash all-in: reflect the burst and execute. Don't roam blindly, but you're strong enough to shove and follow his flanks.
edits.after: This is your zone. With E Solar Snare up you punish every Yone dash — snare him as he E-returns to his spirit and the fight is over before his knockup even threatens. At 6, Rebuttal blunts his Fate Sealed engage and Golden Eclipse executes the follow-up: absorb, then finish. Don't roam blindly, but you're strong enough to shove and follow his flanks.

edits.before: With items you become a reflect wall Yone can't cross. Every all-in he throws — R, E-dash, Q3 knockup — is punishable by your snare and turned around by Golden Eclipse. Peel for your team, hold R for his engage, and you win the extended fight; the only losing pattern is over-extending without Rebuttal or E available.
edits.after: With items you become a wall Yone can't cross. Every all-in he throws — R, E-dash, Q3 knockup — is punishable by your snare, absorbed by Rebuttal, and finished by Golden Eclipse. Peel for your team, hold R for his engage, and you win the extended fight; the only losing pattern is over-extending without Rebuttal or E available.

notes: CHART LEFT ALONE ON PURPOSE: full says Yone wins all 7 rows (HARD 8/10), content and packet say Mel wins all 7, WR 49.04% — pre-existing 7-row layer disagreement I could not adjudicate from the kits; see questionsForUser. Fixed the systematic W/R mix-up (reflect belongs to Rebuttal, execute to Golden Eclipse) and the 'taunt' mislabel of Fate Sealed. Left standing but unverified: 'Searing Brilliance' as the name of Mel's passive (kit file carries no passive name), and the claim Rebuttal 'cancels his committed autos' — W prevents damage so the effect is real even if 'cancel' is loose. Packet defect 'never names Yone's abilities' now partially addressed via the full-layer rewrites (Soul Unbound, Spirit Cleave, Mortal Steel, Fate Sealed all named).
